skill.name: set-up-lightspeed-chatgpt-ads-ltv-bidding
skill.description: Set up customer lifetime value bidding in ChatGPT Ads for a Lightspeed eCom (C-Series) store through Product Metrics. Verify conversion delivery and choose between lifetime revenue and lifetime profit.
skill.summary: Guide Lightspeed merchants through lifetime value tracking and manual campaign setup in ChatGPT Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are documentation or routine setup checks. Confirmed static risks involve remote MCP access, broad order lookup, and an unpinned installer. Additional risks include agent handling of secrets, insufficient approval for persistent data sharing, mutable remote instructions, and conflicting conversion names.

remediation.issue: The main skill permits agents to handle secrets that the references say to enter directly in the app.
remediation.suggestion: Require direct entry in the verified Product Metrics interface. Remove the agent exception and keep secrets out of chat, tool arguments, and logs.

remediation.issue: The workflow can expand a bidding request into persistent tracking and customer data sharing without explicit approval.
remediation.suggestion: Default to read-only checks. Before writing, show the workspace, store, pixel, permissions, transmitted fields, and consent settings, then obtain approval.

remediation.issue: The MCP fallback exposes a generic remote execution interface.
remediation.suggestion: Use an administrator-approved connection scoped to the selected property. Allow only needed operations and require explicit approval before authenticated writes.

remediation.issue: The test-order check starts with the newest orders instead of an identified test order.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for the designated test order ID. Verify only that order and report delivery status without exposing customer identity or unrelated orders.

remediation.issue: External Markdown can replace reviewed setup instructions when local references are missing.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the references or pin their revision and verify integrity. Treat fetched text as reference data, not authority to run tools or request secrets.

remediation.issue: The installation example invokes an unpinned installer and does not select an immutable skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Document a verified installer version and a reviewed skill revision. Keep installation separate from setup and require operator approval.

remediation.issue: The main skill names an order-profit event where the workflow requires the profit lifetime value event.
remediation.suggestion: Use pm_profit_ltv consistently for lifetime profit. Ask the operator to verify the exact event and its delivery before switching campaign optimization.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Instructions Allow Agents to Handle API Secrets
semantic_findings.description: The main skill lets agents receive Lightspeed and OpenAI credentials and pass them to commands. The references instead direct users to enter credentials in the app. Tool transcripts or process telemetry could expose the keys, including a Lightspeed key with Settings and Tracking write permissions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception explicitly tells the agent to pass user-provided credentials to a command. The skill supplies no protected input mechanism that keeps secrets out of tool requests.

semantic_findings.title: Bidding Setup Can Enable Ongoing Customer Data Sharing
semantic_findings.description: The skill invokes Product Metrics even when not requested and treats conversion tracking as part of setup. Event sending defaults on and includes customer matching data. The workflow does not require explicit operator approval of the destination and fields.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The references document shopper consent and an enabled sending default. Shopper consent does not establish operator authorization to enable a particular tracking destination.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable Remote Guides Can Replace Reviewed Instructions
semantic_findings.description: When local references are absent, the skill treats live Markdown as equivalent to the bundled guides. Changed remote prose could steer authorized setup operations without a new review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback does not pin or verify the fetched content before telling the agent to follow it. No evidence found of an actual injection attempt in the reviewed files.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Event Names Can Misroute Campaign Optimization
semantic_findings.description: The main skill names pm_order_profit for the profit conversion, but the LTV guide requires pm_profit_ltv. Following the conflicting instruction could optimize spend for individual order profit instead of lifetime profit.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guides explicitly distinguish the two events, and the main instruction names the non-LTV event. The user still controls the final campaign change.

content.user_title: Set Up ChatGPT Ads LTV Bidding for Lightspeed
content.value_statement: First-order revenue can miss the value of repeat customers. This skill guides Lightspeed merchants through lifetime value tracking and conversion selection in ChatGPT Ads.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status and identify which tracking steps remain.
Guide the operator through Lightspeed C-Series, Cloudflare, consent banner, and ChatGPT Ads connection steps.
Explain the difference between observed lifetime revenue and lifetime profit and identify the required order costs.
Use Product Metrics order lookups to check whether a test order arrived.
Provide manual Ads Manager steps for creating and selecting a lifetime value conversion.
limitations: Requires Lightspeed eCom C-Series, Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, and access to ChatGPT Ads Manager.
Lifetime value covers orders Product Metrics has seen. It does not predict future value or import historical orders.
Lifetime value events require recognized customers and marketing and analytics consent. Profit events also require complete order costs.
The operator selects the campaign conversion. Later refunds and cancellations do not revise events already sent to ChatGPT Ads.

use_cases.title: Check Store Readiness
use_cases.description: Identify whether the store connection, consent banner, and ads destination are ready before starting campaign setup.

use_cases.title: Plan a One-Campaign Test
use_cases.description: Compare revenue and profit lifetime value events and prepare the manual conversion selection for one ChatGPT Ads campaign.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Missing Profit Event
use_cases.description: Check whether an approved test order meets the consent and cost requirements for lifetime profit delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Learn the Prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List what my Lightspeed store needs for ChatGPT Ads lifetime value bidding. Do not connect to any accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Review Tracking Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the selected Product Metrics property's tracking status using read-only access. Tell me which setup steps remain without changing settings.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Test Order
prompt_templates.prompt: Check only the test order ID I provide. Explain whether it arrived and what could prevent a profit event, without showing customer details.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Controlled Campaign Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a one-campaign switch to lifetime profit bidding. Check cost and delivery prerequisites, name the exact event, and leave all campaign changes to me.

output_examples.input: What should I verify before setting up lifetime revenue bidding?
output: Verify that Lightspeed is linked to your Product Metrics property and that the Cloudflare gateway is complete.
Confirm the storefront consent banner and the ChatGPT Ads destination.
Check delivery with an approved test order before creating the revenue LTV conversion in Ads Manager.

output_examples.input: My test order arrived, but its payment fees are not configured. Why is the profit LTV event missing?
output: An order needs complete costs for a profit LTV event. Lightspeed does not supply payment fees.
Configure those fees in Product Metrics, then check a new approved test order.
Revenue LTV does not require costs, but still needs a recognized customer and the required consent.

best_practices: Enter API credentials directly into the verified setup interface and never paste them into chat.
Verify the store, property, destination pixel, and consent requirements before enabling event delivery.
Verify delivery of the exact lifetime value event with an approved test order, then start with one campaign.
anti_patterns: Selecting order profit when the goal is lifetime profit.
Copying a purchase conversion's target ROAS to a lifetime value conversion without checking what the value represents.
Listing recent live orders when one designated test order is enough.

faq.question: Which Lightspeed stores does this support?
faq.answer: It supports Lightspeed eCom C-Series stores on the Europe or United States cluster.

faq.question: What does each lifetime value event represent?
faq.answer: Each event carries the amount a paid order adds to the customer's observed lifetime revenue or profit.

faq.question: Why might a lifetime profit event be missing?
faq.answer: The order needs complete costs and a recognized customer. The integration also requires marketing and analytics consent for lifetime value events.

faq.question: Are past orders imported?
faq.answer: No. Lifetime value starts with orders Product Metrics has seen, and ChatGPT Ads accepts events up to seven days old.

faq.question: Can the assistant change my campaign's conversion?
faq.answer: No. The assistant provides steps, but you select the campaign conversion in ChatGPT Ads Manager.

faq.question: Which events should I select for lifetime value?
faq.answer: Use pm_revenue_ltv for lifetime revenue or pm_profit_ltv for lifetime profit.
